title: arnica louiseana var. illiamnae
intro: Arnica louiseana var. illiamnae, commonly known as Mountain Arnica or Alpine Arnica, is a flowering plant species belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help soothe pain, reduce swelling, and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Arnica are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, making it a popular ingredient in topical creams and ointments. The bioactive constituents of Arnica louiseana var. illiamnae include sesquiterpene lactones (arnic acid, dihydroarnic acid, and others) and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
